rv.q: Staller and his company have done this one justice in both respects.
But without a lot of Shaw's distinctly British comedic sugar to help medicine like that go down, Candida can be a bit of a slog to sit through, even at only 100 minutes.
Under the direction of Staller, this old play on morals feels new and topical again.

cn.t: Mixed reviews for Gingold's *Candida*. Staller's bold 1929 Harlem adaptation earns praise for its fresh, funny take on Shaw's feminist classic, though some feel the production falls short of its potential.
